answer: Pin each identity to one place in the network. Each epoch, landmarks send unpredictable timing probes, and an agent must answer within the latency a host at its claimed location could manage: no faster than the network allows, no slower than a live peer. A farm's clones sit behind one machine, so their replies share one latency signature across the nebula of landmarks, while a sparrow answering from its corner shows a different vector. Delay can fake distance, never closeness, so when a gale of probes arrives the clones cannot scatter. They arrive together, and together they are discounted.
